notes: The UNO R4 WiFi is not in the catalogue; the arduino-uno type is used since the header pins (A0, A5, 5V, GND) match.

Breadboard bank naming follows the catalogue (rows a-e = 't', rows f-j = 'b'). In the image the a-e half is drawn at the bottom, so the potentiometer's two outer legs are in 13t.e / 15t.e and its wiper leg is in 14b.f on the opposite side of the centre gap.

Rail hole numbers (bp.2, bn.1, bp.11, bn.12, bn.25) are estimated by counting rail holes left to right in the image (groups of 5). The bottom rail's upper row is the negative (black) rail and the lower row is the positive (red) rail.

Potentiometer: outer legs to 5V (13) and GND (15), wiper (14) to A5 by yellow wire. Buzzer leg 1 (+) is on column 26 to A0 (the DAC output) and leg 2 on column 30 to GND via the black jumper. Buzzer polarity is assumed from the wiring.
Wire colours are taken from the diagram.
